name: c2o
description: An expert-guided skill suite for clarifying poorly described problems and turning knowledge, creative, or software work into verified outcomes.

interface.shortDescription: Clarify vague problems into verified outcomes.
interface.longDescription: C2O provides eleven coordinated skills for discovering poorly described problems from observable evidence, shaping ambiguous work, guiding newcomers with plain-language recommendations, exploring creative directions, delivering outcomes, implementing software safely, verifying evidence, and preserving useful learning.
defaultPrompt: Something is wrong but I cannot describe it. Help me find where to start.
Interview me plainly and recommend the specialist choices.
Explore and refine this creative brief into a verified artifact.
